analysis: descriptive GCc1 Yang-Zhang volatility calendar summaries
target: unannualized square root of the two-observation Yang-Zhang variance
month_of_year_method: group valid target observations by month number, separately for all, train, and test samples
calendar_month_method: group valid target observations by calendar year and month, separately for all, train, and test samples
interpretation: descriptive summaries only; not a seasonality hypothesis test or evidence of a causal calendar effect
